gloss: to boil up; to seethe; to surge with excitement

definitions.gloss: to boil up; to bubble vigorously; to seethe
definitions.explanation: For a liquid to boil intensely, with steam or bubbles rising energetically.

definitions.gloss: to surge with excitement; to be in an uproar; to be buzzing
definitions.explanation: For a place or group of people to become filled with excitement, enthusiasm, or agitation. Describes a lively, energetic atmosphere.

examples.japanese: お{湯|ゆ}が{沸|わ}き{立|た}っている。
{鍋|なべ}の{中|なか}のスープが{沸|わ}き{立|た}っている。
examples.english: The soup in the pot is bubbling vigorously.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{泡|あわ}を{立|た}てて{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ{温泉|おんせん}の{源泉|げんせん}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a hot spring source bubbling up with large bubbles.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}が{沸|わ}き{立|た}った。
{優勝|ゆうしょう}が{決|き}まり、スタジアムが{沸|わ}き{立|た}った。
examples.english: When the championship was decided, the stadium erupted.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}の{逆転|ぎゃくてん}ゴールに{観客席|かんきゃくせき}が{沸|わ}き{立|た}ち、{歓声|かんせい}が{鳴|な}り{止|や}まなかった。
examples.english: The stands surged with excitement at the player's come-from-behind goal, and the cheering didn't stop.

notes:
Compound of {沸|わ}く (to boil, to well up) and {立|た}つ (to rise), giving a vivid image of steam or energy rising. The figurative sense (sense 2) is very common in sports and entertainment contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会場|かいじょう}が{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: the venue erupts
- {観客|かんきゃく}が{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: the audience buzzes with excitement
- {怒|いか}りが{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: anger surges up
- {期待|きたい}に{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: to buzz with anticipation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {沸|わ}く: to boil; to get excited — simpler and more common, less dramatic
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}がる: to get fired up — focuses on building excitement, especially at events
- {沸騰|ふっとう}する: to boil — more technical/literal for boiling; figuratively means public opinion reaching a boiling point
